summary: Epitaxial SnO2 thin films were deposited on a- and m-cut sapphire substrates using plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) with dibutyltindiacetate (DBTDA) as a precursor. The films exhibited different orientations depending on the substrate cut, with (1 0 1) orientation on a-cut sapphire and (0 0 1) orientation on m-cut sapphire. The films were post-deposition annealed at 600 1C to enhance crystallinity.
evidence: Epitaxial SnO2 thin films were grown on (1 1 0) (a-cut) and (1 0 0) (m-cut) sapphire substrates using plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) with dibutyltindiacetate (DBTDA) as a precursor. The determined in-plane orientation relationships were [0 1 0]SnO2//[0 0 1]Al2O3 and [1 0 1¯ ]SnO2//[1¯ 1 0]Al2O3 (a-cut) and [0 1 0]SnO2//[0 0 1¯ ]Al2O3 and [1 0 0]SnO2//[0 1 0]Al2O3 (m-cut) consistent with the previous reports. The substrate temperature during deposition was maintained at 300 1C. The processing details of PEALD are described elsewhere. All the films were post-deposition annealed at 600 1C to enhance their crystallinity.
